mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_group_source_messages m WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND m.integration_id=#{integration} AND m.group_binding_id=#{group} AND m.source_message_id=#{id}

SELECT FROM nw_group_source_messages m WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND m.integration_id=#{integration} AND m.group_binding_id=#{group} AND m.author_kind='end_user' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_chat_session_outbox o WHERE o.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND o.session_id=m.session_id AND o.event_id='output:group-source:'||m.source_message_id) ORDER BY m.source_sequence LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tenant_id,session_id,event_id,runtime_run_id,session_sequence,event_type,payload::text AS payload_json,created_at, session_sequence AS first_sequence,created_at AS first_created_at FROM nw_chat_session_outbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND session_id=#{session} AND event_type='message.delta' AND payload #>> '{data,message_id}'=#{message} AND (payload #>> '{data,message_version}')::bigint=#{version} ORDER BY session_sequence DESC LIMIT 1
